label: late original-phase / <DEL> steps in sequences starting v/k/2/t/j with several r/x/3/f tokens (weak)
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.012% of steps, ~1.2k sequences), weak magnitudes (mean 0.125, max 0.21). It fires only in the original phase at t>=3 (mostly t=4-8) and on the <DEL> step, and never in the copy phase or at t<=2. Rates go up when the input is r (9.8x lift) or 3, when r/x/n came one or two steps earlier, and when the first token is v, k, 2, t or j. Longer sequences (L=8-9) also raise the rate. These are only tendencies. Conjunctions of them reach at most about 3% precision and 25-35% recall (dev F1 ~0.06), so the feature looks like an idiosyncratic hidden-state combination that no simple input predicate describes. The recorded predicate is the best weak proxy. Magnitude did not track any variable I checked.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=v (+3.69), orig0=k (+3.52), orig0=2 (+3.49), orig0=t (+3.24), orig2=r (+3.22), orig1=3 (+3.14). Lower it: phase=2 (-4.89), prev3_tok=- (-4.43), t=3 (-3.10), orig6=- (-1.56).
